messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Rose plot
parts:
The excellent LearnR blog had a post today about making a rose plot in
ggplot2 (http://learnr.wordpress.com/2010/08/16/consultants-chart-in-ggplot2/).
It can be made even easier with the new ggplot2 GUI included in the
latest version of Deducer. After the template is made, the plot can be
generated with 4 clicks of the mouse. I just made a quick video
tutorial: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHYATHLM5sY

The generated template file is available at:
http://neolab.stat.ucla.edu/cranstats/rose.ggtmpl

Ian

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Rose plot
parts:
The category variable needs to be a factor or character vector. The
GUI tries to be a little smart about converting variables to factors
when it would create an error (notice that fill is converted with
as.factor ), but there is a limit to how well it can guess. Try this
instead:

DF <- data.frame(variable = factor(1:10), value = sample(10, replace = TRUE))

also note that you can edit the aesthetic mapping by hand if you right
click on the variable.

When you click on position a small dialog should appear with a combo
box, two text fields and an okay button. Do you see this dialog? Are
you not able to interact with all the components, or just the combo
box? What version of Mac os, R and Java are you using.

ian

I did find somewhat strange behavior. It seems that I was clicking
once to expand the menus and then clicking again to select the item
from the drop down. This does not work. Clicking and holding the mouse
button down and then scrolling and releasing on the menu item seems to
work. This behavior is consistent in all the menus. The behavior is
also consistent in the menu for the data sets. I can see them all but
have to hold the mouse button down and then release to change data
sets.

The result of the java version check is below:
> .jcall("java/lang/System","S","getProperty","java.version")

[1] "1.6.0_20"

Deselecting "Native looking file chooser" did not seem to have an
effect on the menus. The issue seems to be consistent in all menus I
have tried.

I am running the 32bit version of JGR. I tried switching to the 64bit
version and the behavior remains the same.
